learning_objective: 🎯 We will read about a smart black crow and learn how it uses its brain!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The crow is a black bird. One day, it was very thirsty and looked for water.
It found a pot with very little water at the bottom. It could not reach the water.
The smart crow dropped small stones into the pot. The water came up, and it drank happily!

fun_activity.title: 🪨 The Water Experiment
fun_activity.instructions: Take a glass half full of water. Slowly drop marbles or pebbles into it and watch the water level rise, just like the crow did!

quick_recap: ⭐ A thirsty black crow was looking for water.
⭐ It found a pot, but the water was too low.
⭐ It used stones to bring the water up and quenched its thirst.
